# Etsah

> Etsah is a contract language (DSL) for AI agents: declare effects (read, write, net, spend, emit), budgets, and approval gates, then check the contract statically before anything runs. Author: Ryuji Hashimoto (J-PROUT Inc.). MIT license.

Repository: https://github.com/RyujiHashimoto/etsah. Python 3.12, standard library only. The package is not on PyPI. From a clone, run `python3 etsah.py check` on `.etsah` files. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` is the test command.

Start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) if you will change the tree. Do not refactor the validator in `etsah.py`. Do not publish to PyPI, push a release tag, register names, or post announcements (including MCP registry listings) without approval from Ryuji Hashimoto (J-PROUT Inc.). AI contributors are welcome on the same terms as human contributors.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): How an AI agent should build, test (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`), and contribute. Includes the AI contribution rules that would otherwise live in a separate contributing guide.
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, how to run the checker, the MCP server, and the pattern layer.
- [README.ja.md](README.ja.md): Japanese overview. The English README is the entry point for the agent, MCP, and playground sections.
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): Contract-language design (Japanese, the original). Syntax includes `type`, `op`, `flow`, `agent`, `task`, `gate`, and `policy`. If this file and the translation disagree, this file wins.
- [SPEC.en.md](SPEC.en.md): English translation of `SPEC.md`.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add a pattern manifest, review criteria, and versioning.
- [docs/information-flow.md](docs/information-flow.md): Information-flow labels, sinks, and `declassify`.
- [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md): Diagnostic codes the contract checker and the pattern checker already emit.
- [docs/ai_automation.md](docs/ai_automation.md): Design notes for `agent` / `task` / `gate` / `policy`. The checker is static. `etsah guard` counts `limit calls` and `limit spend`. Cron, the integer-yen budget counter, and an idempotency store are not implemented.
- [docs/staffing.md](docs/staffing.md): Staffing-domain contracts (timesheets, assignment limits, billing rates). Sample data is fictional.
- [docs/en/agents-quickstart.md](docs/en/agents-quickstart.md): Five-minute agent check.
- [docs/en/comparison.md](docs/en/comparison.md): How this differs from a Cedar or OPA policy plus a wrapper.
- [docs/en/mcp.md](docs/en/mcp.md): MCP stdio server (`python3 etsah.py mcp`), guard (`python3 etsah.py guard`), signed one-time approvals (`python3 etsah.py approve`), and the call/spend ledger.
- [docs/mcp.ja.md](docs/mcp.ja.md): Japanese version of the MCP guide.
- [docs/playground/index.html](docs/playground/index.html): Static browser checker. The repository does not enable GitHub Pages by itself.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability.
- [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Contributor Covenant 2.1.

## Examples

- [examples/agents/support_reply.etsah](examples/agents/support_reply.etsah): Passing support-reply contract (fictional ticket). The broken twin is [examples/agents/support_reply_broken.etsah](examples/agents/support_reply_broken.etsah) and fails with `E-POLICY`.
- [examples/ai_tasks.etsah](examples/ai_tasks.etsah): Passing `agent` / `task` contracts. The broken twin is [examples/ai_tasks_broken.etsah](examples/ai_tasks_broken.etsah).
- [examples/refund_fixed.etsah](examples/refund_fixed.etsah): Passing refund contract. The broken twin is [examples/refund_broken.etsah](examples/refund_broken.etsah).
- [examples/information_flow_safe.etsah](examples/information_flow_safe.etsah): Passing information-flow example (`--allow-net email --allow-net analytics`). The leaking twin is [examples/information_flow_leak.etsah](examples/information_flow_leak.etsah).
- [examples/prompt_injection_safe.etsah](examples/prompt_injection_safe.etsah): Fictional inquiry Q-4401. The safe contract keeps a vault token inside. The leaking twin is [examples/prompt_injection_leak.etsah](examples/prompt_injection_leak.etsah) and fails with `E-IFLOW-ARG`. Steps are in [README.md](README.md).
- [examples/staffing.etsah](examples/staffing.etsah) and [examples/staffing_dates.etsah](examples/staffing_dates.etsah): Staffing contracts. Broken twins sit beside them.

## Optional

- [patterns/PATTERNS.md](patterns/PATTERNS.md): Pattern-language design (Japanese).
- [patterns/registry/README.md](patterns/registry/README.md): Registry layout. 27 JSON manifests plus `index.json`.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license text.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Exact CI commands (unit tests, contract checks, broken-example assertions, pattern index, bench).
